name: card

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	const { children, size = "lg", rounded, href, disabled, class: className, ...props }: Props = $props();
	const isLink = $derived(href !== undefined);
</script>

<!-- Render a link when `href` is set; a disabled link drops its href and leaves the tab order. -->
<svelte:element this={isLink ? "a" : "div"} class={["card not-typeset", className]} data-size={size} data-rounded={rounded} data-link={isLink || undefined} data-disabled={disabled || undefined} href={isLink && !disabled ? href : undefined} aria-disabled={isLink && disabled ? true : undefined} role={isLink && disabled ? "link" : undefined} tabindex={isLink && disabled ? -1 : undefined} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</svelte:element>

<style>
	/* Base card */
	.card {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		transition-duration: 150ms;
		transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, opacity;
		transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
		box-sizing: border-box;
		outline: none;
		border: 1px solid var(--border);
		background-color: var(--card);
		color: var(--card-foreground);
		font-size: var(--text-sm);
		line-height: var(--line-height-sm);
		text-decoration: none;
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Hover highlight for link cards */
	.card[data-link]:hover {
		background-color: var(--accent);
		color: var(--accent-foreground);
	}

	/* Keyboard focus ring */
	.card:focus-visible {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent);
		border-color: var(--ring);
	}

	/* Disabled state for cards and links */
	.card[data-disabled] {
		opacity: 50%;
		pointer-events: none;
	}

	/* =============== Sizes =============== */

	/* Large — default */
	/* The large card uses the extra large radius, like shadcn's rounded-xl */
	.card[data-size="lg"] {
		gap: var(--spacing-xl);
		border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
		padding: var(--spacing-xl);
	}

	/* Medium */
	.card[data-size="md"] {
		gap: var(--spacing-lg);
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
		padding: var(--spacing-lg);
	}

	/* Small */
	.card[data-size="sm"] {
		gap: var(--spacing-md);
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
		padding: var(--spacing-md);
	}

	/* Extra small */
	.card[data-size="xs"] {
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
		padding: var(--spacing-sm);
		font-size: var(--text-xs);
		line-height: var(--line-height-xs);
	}

	/* =============== Rounded =============== */

	/* Overrides the size radius; must stay after the size rules */
	.card[data-rounded="xs"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="sm"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="md"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="lg"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="xl"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="2xl"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="3xl"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-3xl);
	}

	.card[data-rounded="4xl"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-4xl);
	}

	/* A true pill; tall content can clip at the corners, so use 3xl or 4xl to stay safe */
	.card[data-rounded="pill"] {
		border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}
{@render children()}
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { FooterProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: FooterProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Footer row for actions or meta text. -->
<footer class={["cardFooter", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</footer>

<style>
	/* Base footer */
	.cardFooter {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { HeaderProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: HeaderProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Header with the title and description, plus an optional trailing action. -->
<header class={["cardHeader", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</header>

<style>
	/* Base header; grid lets the action sit beside both the title and description without a wrapper */
	.cardHeader {
		display: grid;
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		align-items: center;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm) var(--spacing-md);
	}

	/* Adds a trailing column when the header holds an action */
	.cardHeader:has(> :global(.cardAction)) {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
	}

	/* Title and description stay in the first column */
	.cardHeader > :global(:not(.cardAction)) {
		grid-column: 1;
	}

	/* The action spans both rows when a description is present */
	.cardHeader:has(> :global(.cardDescription)) > :global(.cardAction) {
		grid-row: 1 / span 2;
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

description: A container for grouped content with a header, title, description, action, content, and footer, that can render as a link.
